tickets.text: The trigger buys a daily close above the pivot high, a breakout in front of price. My read is elder_5d [7, 10, 10, 7, 10] CORRECTION_REENTRY with mp_state STRONG (R8): the dip-and-reclaim is the entry, and Elder buys at value, not at the new high (C10, C6).
elder_5d [7, 10, 10, 7, 10] CORRECTION_REENTRY: dip-and-reclaim on the last bar; mp 89.0 FADING so R8 half met. W 9>21, LH but HL; D HH/HL. Buy rests at value, not in front of price (C10).
elder_5d [4, 9, 6, 10, 10] CORRECTION_REENTRY, permission event two bars back and held; mp 76.0 FADING, R8 half met. W 9>21 but swing LH/LL; D at the 20-day high, so I wait for value (C10).
W and D HH/HL, 9>21. elder_5d [6, 10, 10, 7, 10] CORRECTION_REENTRY: dip-and-reclaim on the last bar; mp 82.0 FADING so R8 half met. Buy at value (C10).

ADVANCE on a tape my method stands aside from: elder_5d [0, 6, 7, 2, 7] whipsaws across the permission line with elder_pattern INTERRUPTED. One condition alone is a fragment (C9); in transitional ground take nothing (C22), the whipsaw C1 warns of.
